Saif Ali Khan receives death threat; police investigate accused in murder case

Actor Saif Ali Khan has received a death threat. Police have launched a probe into the matter. The threat is reportedly from an accused in the Baba Siddique murder case. Shiv Sena's Neelam Gorhe stated that the government will take action.
